description: This file contains unit tests for the Goteo\Model\Faq class, testing its creation, validation, language support, listing, and deletion functionalities.

classes.name: FaqTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the functionalities of the Faq model in the Goteo application.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests the instantiation of the Faq class.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests the validation status of a new Faq instance.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates a new Faq instance with data, validates, and saves it.

methods.name: testSaveLanguages
methods.description: Tests setting a translation language for the Faq.

methods.name: testCheckLanguages
methods.description: Checks if language translations are correctly retrieved.

methods.name: testListing
methods.description: Tests retrieving all FAQ entries for a section, in different languages.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a FAQ entry and then cleaning up by creating a new and removing it.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Tests behavior when attempting to retrieve or remove a non-existing FAQ.
